skills.name: engineering-principles
skills.description: Evaluate engineering tradeoffs, cohesion and complexity when deciding how to implement or simplify a change.

skills.name: abstraction-auditor
skills.description: Audit interfaces, indirection and coupling to decide which abstractions to retain, simplify or avoid.

skills.name: architecture-guardian
skills.description: Check existing module ownership and dependency direction when a change crosses architectural boundaries.

skills.name: safe-refactoring
skills.description: Refactor an existing implementation with explicit before-and-after evidence that observable contracts remain intact.

skills.name: evidence-code-review
skills.description: Review a diff or pull request for concrete defects with triggering paths, impact and targeted verification.

skills.name: design-patterns
skills.description: Choose patterns for proven variation and lifecycle needs; avoid pattern-driven layers.

skills.name: testing-strategy
skills.description: Select deterministic tests by changed contracts, failure modes, and regression risk.

skills.name: api-contract-integrity
skills.description: Detect drift across HTTP handlers, OpenAPI, DTOs, clients, and authorization.

skills.name: security-by-design
skills.description: Evaluate trust boundaries, authorization, input safety, secrets, and least privilege.

skills.name: performance-engineering
skills.description: Investigate measured latency, throughput, memory, CPU, and database bottlenecks.
